_meta.name: ZIC Decision Engine — Governance Signal Library
_meta.author: Gururaj G J — Independent Fraud & Risk Engineering
_meta.description: Single source-of-truth for all fraud intelligence definitions consumed by the decision engine, dashboards, reviewers, and detection systems. All signal severities, pattern taxonomies, scoring bands, thresholds, and decision logic are defined here and propagated to every consuming system.

changelog.changes: Initial ZIC release — 28 signals, 8 fraud typologies, full scoring and decision framework

Expanded signal library to 107 signals across 12 intelligence domains. Added Device Intelligence, Session & Authentication, Promo & Incentive Abuse, Marketplace & Platform Abuse, Operational Risk, Trust & Safety categories. Added trust_safety and marketplace threshold domains.

Added missing thresholds to ZIC core: transaction.cvv_fail_max_per_card, cvv_fail_max_distinct_cards_device, card_add_velocity_24h_max, mule_inbound_source_min, gift_card thresholds. Added session threshold domain: otp_fail_max_per_account, mfa_fail_max, simultaneous_geo_sessions_max. Added identity.sim_activation_min_days. Clarified DL_002 note: MUL_001 and NET_005 are signal IDs not typology IDs.

CRITICAL.label: Critical
CRITICAL.description: Immediate risk — active exploitation patterns present. Automatic action required.

HIGH.label: High
HIGH.description: Elevated risk — strong behavioural indicators observed. Manual review required within 4 hours.

MEDIUM.label: Medium
MEDIUM.description: Moderate risk — emerging patterns, escalation monitoring required.

LOW.label: Low
LOW.description: Low risk — early signal, log and monitor only.

scoring_bands.label: Clear
scoring_bands.description: No significant risk indicators. Allow transaction or action.

scoring_bands.label: Elevated
scoring_bands.description: Low-level signals present. Log, monitor, and apply passive controls.

scoring_bands.label: Suspicious
scoring_bands.description: Multiple signals detected. Apply step-up verification before proceeding.

scoring_bands.label: High Risk
scoring_bands.description: Strong fraud indicators. Route to manual review queue immediately.

scoring_bands.label: Critical
scoring_bands.description: High-confidence fraud pattern. Block and escalate to fraud operations team.

ALLOW.label: Allow
ALLOW.description: Permit the transaction or action without friction.

MONITOR.label: Monitor
MONITOR.description: Permit but flag for passive monitoring. Log all subsequent actions.

STEP_UP.label: Step-Up Verification
STEP_UP.description: Require additional authentication before proceeding (OTP, biometric, document).

VELOCITY_LIMIT.label: Velocity Limit
VELOCITY_LIMIT.description: Apply transaction velocity caps or session limits.

MANUAL_REVIEW.label: Manual Review
MANUAL_REVIEW.description: Route to human fraud analyst review queue. Pause action pending outcome.

SOFT_BLOCK.label: Soft Block
SOFT_BLOCK.description: Temporarily suspend action. Allow appeal. Notify user.

BLOCK.label: Block
BLOCK.description: Block transaction or action. Do not notify user of fraud reason.

SUSPEND.label: Account Suspend
SUSPEND.description: Suspend account pending full fraud investigation.

TERMINATE.label: Account Terminate
TERMINATE.description: Permanently close account. Initiate SAR if required.

ESCALATE_SAR.label: Escalate — SAR
ESCALATE_SAR.description: Escalate to compliance for Suspicious Activity Report filing.

thresholds._note: All consuming systems MUST read thresholds from this section. No hardcoded values.

signals.description: Device fingerprint at registration differs from device used in KYC flow within threshold window.
Same identity document hash submitted across multiple accounts within rolling window.
signals.detection_logic: document_hash in existing_accounts AND count > threshold

signals.description: Email domain registered fewer than 7 days before account creation. Throwaway identity indicator.
Registration IP geolocation inconsistent with country or state on submitted identity document.
Navigation speed, click patterns, or session timing during KYC flow inconsistent with human behaviour.
Registration email domain matches known disposable or temporary email provider list.
Mobile number assigned to current user was released and reassigned within the past 90 days.
Optical character recognition confidence score on submitted document falls below acceptable threshold, suggesting alteration.
Liveness selfie face match against submitted document falls below minimum confidence threshold.

signals.signal_name: Multiple Identities From Same Browser Hash
signals.description: Two or more distinct identity documents submitted from the same browser fingerprint hash.
SIM card used for registration activated fewer than 7 days before onboarding attempt.
More than 3 account registrations initiated from the same device fingerprint within a 24-hour window.
Registration IP has a reputation score below minimum threshold, indicating proxy, VPN, or Tor usage.
Residential address on government ID differs significantly from address provided during registration.
Same PAN or Aadhaar number linked to more than one active account, indicating identity sharing or duplication.
Device telemetry indicates Android or iOS emulator, or virtual machine. Common in automated fraud.
Device has been rooted (Android) or jailbroken (iOS), removing standard security controls.
Device timezone does not match IP geolocation timezone. Indicates spoofed location or VPN usage.
Device language setting inconsistent with registration country and IP geolocation.
Canvas rendering fingerprint matches known spoofing tools or anti-fingerprinting browser extensions.
Multiple hardware and software signals consistent with virtual machine execution environment.
Browser fingerprint entropy score is abnormally low or high, indicating fabricated or uniform fingerprint.
Single device fingerprint used to access accounts from geographically distant locations within short time.
ML model assigns high probability that device fingerprint has been fabricated or is being actively spoofed.
Login from a location physically impossible to reach from previous login location given elapsed time.

signals.signal_name: Password Reset Followed by Device Change
signals.description: Password reset and device fingerprint change occur within 60 minutes of each other. Classic ATO pattern.
Multiple failed MFA attempts followed by successful authentication using a different method.
Account inactive for 90+ days suddenly becomes active with high-value or sensitive action.
Same account has active authenticated sessions from two or more geographically distinct locations simultaneously.
Session cookie reused after apparent logout, or same cookie ID observed from multiple IP addresses.
More than 10 authentication attempts against a single account within a 5-minute window.
Account login occurs at time significantly outside the user's established historical login pattern.
signals.detection_logic: login_hour not in user_typical_hours AND deviation_score > 2.5

signals.description: ML model assigns high probability of active session hijack based on combined session telemetry signals.
Post-login session switches to an IP address flagged as high-risk (TOR, proxy, known fraud infrastructure).
Page navigation speed exceeds maximum possible human interaction speed. Indicates scripted access.
Request headers, WebDriver properties, or canvas fingerprint indicate headless browser or automation framework.
signals.detection_logic: navigator.webdriver == true OR canvas_fp in headless_signatures

signals.description: Session completed in fewer than 8 seconds — insufficient for legitimate human interaction.
Username and password fields filled via clipboard paste. Common in credential stuffing.

signals.signal_name: Multiple Account Access From Same Device
signals.description: Single device fingerprint associated with 3+ distinct account sessions in rolling window.
User completes terms/consent screens without any scroll events. Indicates automated form completion.
All form fields completed in under 2 seconds total. Indicates autofill automation or scripted entry.
Keystroke timing between characters is perfectly uniform — inconsistent with human typing variability.
User navigates the same page sequence more than 5 times in a single session without variation.
Zero mouse movement or keyboard input detected during transaction flow — suggests scripted transaction.

signals.signal_name: First Transaction to New High-Value Beneficiary
signals.description: First-ever transaction to a new beneficiary exceeds high-value threshold.

signals.signal_name: Refund Request Within 2 Hours of Purchase
signals.description: Refund or chargeback request initiated within 2 hours of purchase. Primary refund abuse indicator.
More than 5 transactions in a 15-minute window. Indicates automated or coordinated fraud.
3+ consecutive transactions with exact round-number amounts. Common in structuring.

signals.signal_name: Card BIN Inconsistent With Account Geography
signals.description: Card BIN country does not match account registration geography beyond distance threshold.
Large transaction split into multiple smaller transactions just below reporting or threshold limits.
signals.detection_logic: txn_count >= 3 AND all_amounts < limit_threshold AND sum_amounts > limit_threshold

signals.description: 3 or more new beneficiaries added within a 30-minute window. Indicates pre-exfiltration setup.
Transaction initiated between midnight and 5am, significantly outside user's historical transaction hours.
signals.detection_logic: txn_hour between 0 and 5 AND NOT in user_typical_txn_hours

signals.description: Transaction destination country assigned HIGH risk rating and inconsistent with account's transaction history.
signals.detection_logic: destination_country_risk == HIGH AND destination_country NOT in user_history

signals.description: Multiple very small transactions (< ₹10) sent to same beneficiary within short window. Card validation probing.
Payment instrument country of issue does not match account holder's registered country.
Device fingerprint shared across 3+ distinct registered accounts.
Referral chain depth exceeds 4 levels. Indicates coordinated referral farming network.

signals.signal_name: Promo Redemption Within Minutes of Eligibility
signals.description: Promotional credit redeemed within 10 minutes of eligibility. Indicates automation.
Multiple accounts registered within 5-minute window from similar IP ranges.
Outbound transfer initiated within 30 minutes of account funding. Primary mule indicator.
Transaction graph analysis reveals funds cycling through 3+ accounts before returning to origin. Layering indicator.
Same card or payment instrument used across 2+ distinct accounts with different registered identities.
ML graph model assigns high probability that account is part of an organised fraud ring.
Multiple unrelated accounts share the same outbound beneficiary. Indicates converging mule network.
Account's transaction network graph has unusually high density — too many connections for legitimate use case.
ML model assigns high probability of systematic referral farming based on account network patterns.
Account redeems promotional offers at rate significantly higher than cohort average.
Same device fingerprint used to claim rewards across multiple reward programme accounts.
Multiple reward abuse incidents clustered from the same geographic area or IP subnet.
Referral chain contains accounts sharing device, IP, or identity signals — indicating fabricated referral network.
Account claims reward then immediately converts and withdraws without platform engagement.
Unusually high proportion of campaign redemptions from accounts with overlapping identity or device signals.
Rapid unusual increase in positive seller reviews correlated with accounts sharing device or IP signals.
Multiple reviews for same seller/product from accounts sharing device, IP, or registration timestamp.
Seller creates multiple near-identical listings, often to manipulate search rankings or bypass suspensions.
Account has return rate significantly above platform cohort average, or returns items claimed as undelivered.
Transaction graph reveals circular buyer-seller relationships between accounts with shared signals — washing trades.
Seller initiates payout immediately after first sale, before delivery confirmation. Risk of non-delivery fraud.
Buyer triggers escrow dispute immediately after funds released, or pattern matches known escrow manipulation.

signals.signal_name: Multiple Inbound Sources to Single Outbound
signals.description: Multiple small inbounds from distinct sources aggregated to single large outbound. Classic layering.

signals.signal_name: New Beneficiary Account Age Under 48 Hours
signals.description: Outbound transfer destination account created fewer than 48 hours before receiving funds.

signals.signal_name: Account Dormancy Followed by Sudden Activity
signals.description: Account inactive for 90+ days initiates high-value outbound transactions. Aged mule typology.
Account outbound transaction value exceeds 90% of total inbound value within 7-day rolling window.
Progressive increase in cashout frequency and value over 30 days, consistent with mule account maturing.
Funds pass through 2+ jurisdictions within 24 hours with no plausible commercial reason.
Payment reference narrative inconsistent with account profile, geography, or transaction history.
Review queue volume projected to exceed analyst capacity within 4 hours based on current ingestion rate.
Cases in escalation queue have exceeded defined SLA threshold without resolution.
ML model assigns high probability that analyst will abandon case before resolution based on case complexity.
False-negative rate for a signal or model has increased significantly over trailing 7-day window.
Unusual spike in suppressed or auto-closed alerts without analyst action. Potential rule fatigue or bypass.
Specific fraud rule has fired continuously for 7+ days with low actioning rate, indicating analyst desensitisation.
Specific analyst's case disposition rate diverges significantly from team consensus on similar case types.
Multiple accounts sending abusive or threatening content to same target within a short window.
Account trust score has declined progressively over 14 days based on community reports and platform signals.
Account sending messages at rate and uniformity inconsistent with human behaviour. Spam bot indicator.
New account shares device, IP, or identity signals with a previously banned account.
Coordinated engagement (likes, follows, shares) from accounts sharing device or registration signals.
Account generating policy-violating content at volume significantly above platform cohort norms.
Agent approval or override amount exceeds their designated authority limit.
Agent approves 5+ transactions within 15 minutes without standard review intervals.
Agent approves high-value transaction outside defined business hours (10pm–6am).
Agent account fewer than 30 days old processing cases above standard value thresholds.
Agent approves transaction or case where they are listed as beneficiary or related party.
Single agent repeatedly approves high-value cases for the same customer — potential collusion.
Same agent credentials used from multiple device fingerprints simultaneously or in rapid succession.
Case activity log shows edits or status changes outside normal workflow sequence.

signals.signal_name: Bulk Gift Card Purchase on New Account
signals.description: Large gift card purchase volume on a newly created account. Strong indicator of gift card fraud or money laundering via prepaid instruments.

signals.signal_name: CVV Failure Velocity on Single Card
signals.description: Multiple CVV failures on the same card within a session. Indicates brute-force card validation attack.

signals.signal_name: High Distinct Card Attempts Per Device
signals.description: More than 5 distinct cards attempted from a single device within 15 minutes. Primary card-testing ring indicator.
5 or more distinct cards added to account within 24 hours. Indicates mule account being loaded with stolen card data.
5 or more OTP failures on the same account within a session. Indicates OTP brute-force or SIM-swap followup attempt.

signals.signal_name: First High-Value UPI Transfer to New VPA
signals.description: First UPI payment to a new Virtual Payment Address exceeds high-value threshold. Elevated mule and ATO risk.
signals.detection_logic: is_new_beneficiary AND payment_rail == UPI AND txn_amount >= threshold

signals.signal_name: Remote Access App Active During UPI Transaction
signals.description: Remote access or screen-sharing application active while a UPI payment is initiated. Primary scam indicator — victim is being coached.

ATO_001.description: Unauthorised access to a legitimate account through credential theft, social engineering, or session hijacking.

subtypes.name: Credential Stuffing
subtypes.description: Automated use of leaked username/password combinations across multiple accounts.

subtypes.name: SIM Swap ATO
subtypes.description: SIM swap used to intercept OTP and gain account access.

subtypes.name: Session Hijacking
subtypes.description: Active session token stolen post-authentication.

subtypes.name: Trusted Device Spoofing
subtypes.description: Fraudster spoofs a previously trusted device fingerprint to bypass 2FA.

ATO_001.typical_outcome: Fund exfiltration, unauthorized purchases, account data theft

SYN_001.description: Fabricated identity constructed from real and fictitious data elements to pass KYC verification.

subtypes.name: Frankenstein Identity
subtypes.description: Real SSN/Aadhaar combined with fabricated name, address, and date of birth.

subtypes.name: Slow-Burn Synthetic
subtypes.description: Synthetic identity aged over 30–90 days before executing fraud.

subtypes.name: Document Fabrication
subtypes.description: AI-generated or altered identity documents passing visual KYC checks.

SYN_001.typical_outcome: Credit fraud, lending fraud, account farming

PRO_001.description: Coordinated exploitation of referral, bonus, or promotional programmes across multiple accounts or devices.

subtypes.name: Referral Farming
subtypes.description: Organised network creating multiple accounts to generate referral rewards.

subtypes.name: Bonus Abuse
subtypes.description: Sign-up or deposit bonuses claimed through multiple identities.

subtypes.name: Promo Credit Resale
subtypes.description: Promotional credits converted to cash value and resold on secondary markets.

PRO_001.typical_outcome: Financial loss through reward exploitation, platform ecosystem distortion

FAK_001.description: Organised creation of inauthentic accounts to inflate metrics, manipulate platforms, or enable downstream fraud.

subtypes.name: Bot Account Creation
subtypes.description: Automated account registration using scripts and emulators.

subtypes.name: Coordinated Fake Network
subtypes.description: Human-operated fake accounts acting in coordination from shared infrastructure.

FAK_001.typical_outcome: Platform manipulation, downstream fraud enablement, metric inflation

MUL_001.description: Account used as intermediary to receive and transfer illicit funds, enabling money laundering.

subtypes.name: Witting Mule
subtypes.description: Account holder knowingly participates in fund movement.

subtypes.name: Unwitting Mule
subtypes.description: Account holder deceived into receiving and forwarding funds.

subtypes.name: Aged Mule Account
subtypes.description: Dormant account reactivated specifically for mule activity.

MUL_001.typical_outcome: Money laundering, AML regulatory exposure, financial loss

TXF_001.description: Fraudulent payment transactions including card fraud, refund abuse, and chargeback fraud.

subtypes.name: Card-Not-Present Fraud
subtypes.description: Stolen card details used for online purchases.

subtypes.name: Refund Abuse
subtypes.description: Deliberate purchase and immediate refund to extract value.

subtypes.name: Chargeback Fraud
subtypes.description: Legitimate goods received but payment disputed via chargeback.

INT_001.description: Fraudulent activity facilitated by internal agents, employees, or authorised operators exceeding their authority.

subtypes.name: Authority Bypass
subtypes.description: Agent approves transactions exceeding their designated authority limit.

subtypes.name: Collusion Fraud
subtypes.description: Agent in coordination with external fraudster to approve fraudulent cases.

subtypes.name: Ghost Transaction
subtypes.description: Agent creates or approves transactions for non-existent or inactive customers.

INT_001.typical_outcome: Financial loss, regulatory exposure, reputational damage

INV_001.description: Victim deceived into transferring funds under false promise of investment returns or fee recovery.

subtypes.name: Advance Fee Scam
subtypes.description: Victim pays upfront fee for promised larger return that never materialises.

subtypes.name: Recovery Scam
subtypes.description: Previous fraud victim targeted again with false promise of recovering lost funds.

subtypes.name: Pig Butchering
subtypes.description: Long-term social engineering leading victim to invest in fraudulent crypto platform.

INV_001.typical_outcome: Significant victim financial loss, reputational damage to platform

decision_logic._note: Composite rules that combine multiple signals. Applied AFTER individual signal scoring.

rules.description: If BEH_002 (headless browser) AND BEH_004 (paste credentials) both fire, add compound score.
If NET_005 AND MUL_001 both fire, immediately escalate regardless of score band.
rules._note: MUL_001 and NET_005 are signal IDs. action_override changed SUSPEND -> BLOCK: at BAND_05 compound drain pattern warrants hard stop, not investigation hold.

rules.description: If IDN_002 AND IDN_005 both fire, escalate to manual review regardless of individual scores.
If NET_001 AND NET_003 both fire, apply velocity limits and flag for review.
Any score above 85 triggers BLOCK regardless of individual signal actions.
